text:
mara: kicking off AZ4 GPU cluster bootstrap runbook draft. pinging infra leads for quick review. checklist below — want signoff + any known caveats before we hand to oncall. :eyes:

mara: BOOTSTRAP CHECKLIST (draft)
- Provision VPC/subnets (private-only), route tables, nat gateways in az4
- Create GPU instance pool (p4d.24xlarge for baseline, fallback to a10g for burst)
- Attach SGs: node<>controlplane, docker registry, metrics egress
- Configure kubeadm join tokens via secrets manager (expiry 12h)
- Apply admission webhooks & network policies
- Deploy node-exporter, gpu-exporter, prometheus-sd config
- Run post-provision validations (see commands below)
- Tag resources with cost-center=redwood and cluster=az4-prod
- Hand off to oncall with runbook link + rollback steps

mara: Post-provision validation commands (run from jumpbox):
```bash
# nodes up
kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kube/az4 get nodes -o wide
# check GPUs visible
kubectl -n kube-system exec -it node-exporter -- nvidia-smi || true
# sanity: run tiny inference job to validate CUDA/NCCL
kubectl run -it --rm smoke-test --image=redwoodci/gpu-smoke:latest --restart=Never -- nvidia-smi && python /tests/quick_infer.py
```

anil: looks solid. two quick asks: 1) add NIC firmware check for a100/p4d images (we've seen hangs if firmware < 3.2). 2) include a pod disruption budget for control plane deployments.

devon: note on networking: az4's transit gateway has an MTU of 8950, but some partner overlay VXLAN defaults to 1500 -> we hit fragmentation on multi-packet RPCs during model shard syncs. workaround: set overlay MTU to 8950 or enforce path MTU discovery. saw this in staging last week.

mara: good catch, i'll add a Known Issues section. suggested wording?

devon: "Known issue: VXLAN/overlay MTU mismatch causing large RPC fragmentation during model shard transfers. Symptom: stalled ray/tensorflow ops with retransmits. Mitigation: set overlay MTU=8950 on agent config or disable jumbo frames on transit. Temporary workaround: use smaller chunk_size for model sync (env REDWOOD_SYNC_CHUNK=64MB)."

anil: also add a validation step to run a 10-minute perf run to ensure latency P95 < 120ms for small-ctx (<512) tokens on p4d baseline. We should fail handoff if >5% requests exceed SLO.

sylvie: on cost tagging — can we ensure ReservedType label is set (dedicated vs burst) and billing tag for K8S node pools? Last time billing team missed az3 because tag key was cluster-name instead of cost-center.

mara: yes. I'll enforce terraform tag module to include: ["cost-center","cluster","reserved-type","owner"] and add a CI check to block untagged resources.

ops-bot: Scheduled job: infra/az4-bootstraps/validate-run triggered by mara at 1763501300. Status: queued.

anil: one more: add a step to run `ethtool -S` on nodes to verify no dropped Rx packets after stress. Past incident: cheap NIC driver reported no errors but kernel counters showed drops during NCCL all-reduce. Command: `sudo ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "rx_|tx_"`

mara: will add. Also adding explicit rollback: snapshot AMIs before bootstrap and a terraform destroy plan (dry-run) to validate rollback commands.

oncall-bot: @mara assigned oncall shift handoff to @devon for az4 monitoring. Shift starts 2026-02-20T08:00Z.

sylvie: can we get cost estimate for steady 150 GPU baseline? rough numbers for finance: p4d at X/hr + storage + egress. maybe a quick calc in runbook?

mara: added a Cost Estimation section placeholder. will fill with numbers after infra runbook PR. For now: link to cost-calc spreadsheet and tag the finance reviewer.

anil: approve from infra (minor edits). :thumbsup:

devon: approve from runtime (added the MTU and NIC checks) :shipit:

mara: thanks all — i'll update the runbook and open PR. plan to cut a stable AMI with validated drivers and then schedule handoff next Tue. If anyone wants to add more checks (stress tests, perf suites), drop them here or add to the PR. :raised_hands:
